---
title: "Commands"
---

Reference for every `vstol` command. Most workflows begin with
[`vcf2tsv`](vcf2tsv.qmd) to standardize a caller's VCF into the Occam's Variant
Grammar TSV, then apply the operations below to the resulting lists.

## Available Commands

| Command | Description |
|:--------|:------------|
| [`annotate`](annotate.qmd) | Annotate variants with gene-level context. |
| [`collapse`](collapse.qmd) | Collapse a merged list into one row per group, applying somatic filters. |
| [`diff`](diff.qmd) | Output the variants specific to a target list. |
| [`intersect`](intersect.qmd) | Identify variants shared across variant lists. |
| [`merge`](merge.qmd) | Merge multiple variant lists into one. |
| [`overlap`](overlap.qmd) | Identify variants overlapping genomic regions. |
| [`vcf2tsv`](vcf2tsv.qmd) | Convert a VCF file to the Occam's Variant Grammar TSV. |
